claims.statement: HAK evidence bookkeeping rejects invalid observation/receipt state and identity combinations covered by the focused regression suite.
Terminal receipt canonical digest detects post-materialization content changes covered by the focused regression suite.
Qualification plan identity and execution workflow identity remain distinct, while an explicit plan-execution join rejects workflow or plan-document mismatch.

required_checks.description: Resolve and assert exact PR head checkout.
Lint the machine-readable HAK-007 qualification plan.
Lint all materialized HAK execution observations.
Exercise explicit plan-to-execution conformance with distinct plan-document and workflow identities.

required_negative_cases: NotEstablished binding mislabeled as an established plan
qualification plan artifact conflated with execution workflow artifact
execution workflow does not conform to qualification plan scope
supplied qualification plan document does not match plan_ref path
